label: copy phase of length-3 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step). Its main mode is length-3 sequences: on both copy-phase input steps (t=4,5) it is active about 95% of the time, and these hold about 73% of activation mass. The strongest activations are at t=4, the first copy step (input = original token 0, output = original token 1), and they reach the max (for example o c d <DEL> [o]). The second copy step is weaker. The remaining ~27% of mass is a diffuse, low-magnitude tail in longer sequences, almost always 1-3 steps before the end of the copy (to_go <= 2). It is strongest for L=4 (4% rate) and modulated by the input token (2, o, h are elevated), and it is not captured cleanly. The tail is why recall by step count is only ~0.38. It never fires on the first occurrence of a token, and it is inactive in the original phase and at the delimiter.
